responsibility: Implements BPF ABI classification for `FnAbi`, forcing aggregates and values wider than 64 bits to indirect passing and widening smaller scalar arguments and returns to 32 bits.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `asm/bpf.rs` and `spec/base/bpf.rs`, this BPF file is specifically about function-call ABI classification: it decides when arguments/returns become indirect and when scalars are widened, not inline-asm registers or reusable target options.
